scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I trust that you are enjoying
life as a Super Novice? Ah,
good good...just as I expected.
Verily, the light of mediocrity is shining brightly within you...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我相信你正享受着
超级初心者的生活吧？啊，
很好很好……正如我所料。
的确，平庸之光在你体内闪耀着……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I encourage you to live
life as Mister Kimu-Shaun did...
Become a Jack of All Trades...
...and a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我鼓励你像金木 Shaun 先生那样生活……
成为一个万事通……
……却无一精通。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Ah, you've brought the
items I've requested!
You've proven yourself
worthy of joining our
Super Novice Society.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
啊，你带来了
我要求的物品！
你证明了自己
有资格加入我们的
超级初心者协会。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Then, as promised, I will
change your job into a
^3355FFSuper Novi--^000000Huh?
What's that behind you?
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
那么，按照约定，我将
把你的职业转变为
^3355FF超级初——^000000嗯？
你身后那是什么？

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 嗯？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou look behind you, but...
There's nothing's there.
Something fishy is going on here!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你回头看去，但是……
那里什么都没有。
这里有些不对劲！^000000

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Bwaha! I got you!
So...how do you like my joke?
Oh well, let's forget that...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
哇哈哈！骗到你了！
那么……你觉得我的玩笑怎么样？
哦算了，忘掉那个吧……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
As well as any possible
reason a grown man such as
myself would carry around
a pair of Panties.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
以及任何可能的
理由，解释像我这样的成年男子
为什么会随身携带
一条内裤。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
The important thing is...
you have joined the esteemed
ranks of the great Super Novices.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
重要的是……
你已经加入了伟大的
超级初心者的尊贵行列。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Consider these Panties a gift...
This very garment is rumored
to be worn by Mister Kimu-Shaun,
our legendary club founder, in
his early days in striving for
exemplary mediocrity.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
把这条内裤当作礼物收下吧……
这件衣物据传是我们传奇的
俱乐部创始人金木 Shaun 先生，
在他早年追求卓越平庸时
所穿过的。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Go out, and enjoy your new life
as a Super Novice! Venture
forth and help the common
man, while being one at at
the same time!
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
去吧，享受你作为
超级初心者的新生活！
勇往直前，帮助普通人，
同时自己也成为其中一员！

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Huh? Did you forget what I
wanted from you? Okay,
I will let you know once
again. Please remember
this time...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯？你忘了我想要什么吗？好吧，
我再告诉你一次。这次请记好……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I asked you to bring me
^FF000030 Sticky Mucus^000000 and
^FF000030 Resin^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我让你给我带来
^FF000030个粘稠液体^000000和
^FF000030个树脂^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
...Hmm?
Stop.
Let me look at you.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
……嗯？
停下。
让我看看你。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I see that the light
of mediocrity shines
brightly within you...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我看到平庸之光
在你体内
闪耀着……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Why don't you join us,
young Novice? Join
us and learn the subtle
greatness of being
mediocre...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
年轻的初心者，何不加入我们？
加入我们要学习
平庸中微妙的伟大……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Accept my offer...
Cast off your those
brown, dusty garments
and bloom into...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
接受我的提议……
脱下那些
棕色、布满灰尘的衣服，
绽放成为……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
...a ^CE6300Super Novice^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
……一名^CE6300超级初心者^000000。

scripts.text: Accept his offer.
scripts.translation: 接受他的提议。

scripts.text: Reject his offer.
scripts.translation: 拒绝他的提议。

scripts.text: Listen more carefully.
scripts.translation: 更仔细地倾听。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmm...But do you truly
appreciate the value of
finding strength in
weakness? You must
prove to me that you
are a true underachiever.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯……但你真的欣赏
在弱点中寻找力量的价值吗？
你必须向我证明
你是一个真正的低成就者。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Live life as a Novice...
And return when you
have mastered the
Basic Skills...
Grow in mediocrity and
Become a Level 10 Novice...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
以初心者的身份生活……
当你掌握了
基本技能后回来……
在平庸中成长，
成为10级的初心者……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmm...But do you truly
value the relaxed lifestyle
of the banal adventurer?
Prove to me that you do not
lust for power...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯……但你真的珍视
平凡冒险者的悠闲生活方式吗？
向我证明你不渴望力量……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Live life mundanely...
Become a Level 45 Novice...
It will be then that you can join us...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
过平凡的生活……
成为45级的初心者……
那时你才能加入我们……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I can see in your eyes
the determination to
live life simply...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我从你的眼中看到了
过简单生活的决心……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Only the truly wise can
see that being ordinary
and banal is the best
way to live life.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
只有真正有智慧的人才能明白，
平凡和普通是
生活的最佳方式。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
However, we do not welcome
just anyone into our society.
You must first pass our
qualification test.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
然而，我们并不欢迎
任何人加入我们的协会。
你必须先通过我们的
资格考试。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
For this test, you must
bring me some items which
are dropped from normal,
unexceptional monsters.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
在这次测试中，你必须
给我带来一些由普通、
不起眼的魔物掉落的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmmmm...
^FF000030 Sticky Mucus^000000
and ^FF000030 Resin
^000000will be suitable to test your
ability to fight meager enemies.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯……
^FF000030个粘稠液体^000000
和^FF000030个树脂
^000000适合用来测试你对抗
弱小敌人的能力。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Also, the number 30
is significant. It's not
anything special...just
an ordinary number.
Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
另外，数字30很有意义。
它没什么特别的……只是
一个普通的数字。
哈哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Good luck, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
祝你好运，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Well, well...I suppose the
value of the simple life
is difficult for you to
to grasp. It's...okay...
Your life is your own.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
好吧，好吧……我想简单生活的
价值对你来说很难理解。
没关系……
你的生活是你自己的。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
But, if you ever see the
light of banality, you
are welcome to visit me
anytime...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
但是，如果你 ever 看到
平凡之光，
欢迎你随时来找我……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
As our Novice club
grows more popular and
we gain more followers,
we may consider using
a more difficult test...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
随着我们的初心者俱乐部
越来越受欢迎，
信徒越来越多，
我们可能会考虑使用
更难的测试……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Our Novice Society was founded
by the legendary Mister
Kimu-Shaun...perhaps the
greatest man in our generation.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我们的初心者协会是由传奇的
金木 Shaun 先生创立的……
也许是我们这一代最伟大的人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
He realized that there
was much suffering in the
world, especially among
the common people of
Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
他意识到世界上有很多苦难，
尤其是米德加尔特的
普通民众……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
He learned many skills from
all the different people he
met...but since he didn't
stay in one place for long,
he became a jack of all
trades...and a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
他从遇到的不同人那里
学到了很多技能……
但由于他在一个地方待不久，
他成了万事通……
却无一精通。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
In sharing the pain of
the common man, he became
became one himself...
the greatest ordinary
man ever.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
通过分担普通人的痛苦，
他自己也成为了其中一员……
有史以来最伟大的普通人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
The members of our society
try to live as Mister
Kimu-Shaun did, according to
the principles he laid before us...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我们协会的成员
试图按照金木 Shaun 先生
为我们制定的原则，
像他那样生活……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
How do you like living
life simply as a Super
Novice? I'm sure that
you're enjoying it~
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
你喜欢作为超级初心者
简单的生活吗？我相信
你很享受~

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Please grow as a Super
Novice by helping the
common man while being
one at the same time...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
请作为一名超级初心者成长，
在帮助普通人的同时，
自己也成为其中一员……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I encourage you to
grow in your Super
Noviceness, and lead
an example in living
an exceptionally
mundane life.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我鼓励你在超级初心者的道路上
成长，并在过极其
平凡的生活中树立榜样。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hello, I am Tzerero,
the unofficial executive
director of the Great
Novice Society.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
你好，我是泽雷罗，
伟大初心者协会的
非官方执行总监。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmmm...you seem to be well
above the average person.
Yes, you're definitely more
'extraordinary' than you are
'ordinary...'
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯……你似乎远高于平均水平。
是的，你绝对比“普通”
更“非凡”……

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
*Sigh* I suppose you
could never understand
our way of life, the
subtle greatness in
being ordinary. But
that's alright.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
*叹气* 我想你永远无法理解
我们的生活方式，
即平凡中微妙的伟大。但
没关系。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Well...there are thousands
of different people in this
world, so I just try to accept
all of our differences.
I hope you will too.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
好吧……这个世界上有成千上万
不同的人，所以我只是试着接受
所有的差异。
希望你也一样。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
You! Stronger than before.
I knew you could pass the test~
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
你！比以前更强了。
我就知道你能通过测试~

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Hm? Hey, you're a member
of our great Novice Society,
aren't you? Isn't this the
best club ever?!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
嗯？嘿，你是我们伟大的
初心者协会的成员，对吧？
这不是最好的俱乐部吗？！

scripts.text:
[Essaray]
Living life mundanely,
according to the principles
of Mister Kimu-Shaun...
It's great to be ordinary!
scripts.translation:
[艾萨雷]
按照金木 Shaun 先生的原则，
过平凡的生活……
平凡真好！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Let's try to lead our lives
as normally as we can!
For your reference, I am
the number one member,
under Mister Tzerero of
course!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
让我们尽量过正常的生活吧！
供你参考，我是
第一号成员，
当然是在泽雷罗先生之下！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Hah~ you don't know anything
about being a normal person yet!
Why don't you join our Novice
Society? This club is the best in the world~
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
哈~你还不懂如何做一个正常人！
何不加入我们的初心者协会？
这个俱乐部是世界上最好的~

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Yup, Super Novices
are the best characters!
Hahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
没错，超级初心者
是最好的角色！
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Bah~! You're better than
average...Hell, you may
even be 'special.'
What a shame! Well...
I hope you still live
your life positively.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
呸~！你比平均水平强……
该死，你甚至可能很“特别”。
真可惜！好吧……
希望你仍然积极地生活。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello, Mister Super Novice~
You must have been really
dissapointed that the other
Kafra Employees wouldn't let
you rent a cart from them.
But don't you worry now...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
你好，超级初心者先生~
其他卡普拉服务员不让你
租用手推车，你一定很失望吧。
但现在别担心……

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello, Super Novice, Ma'am.
You must have been really
dissapointed that the other
Kafra Employees wouldn't let
you rent a cart from them.
But don't you worry now...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
你好，超级初心者女士。
其他卡普拉服务员不让你
租用手推车，你一定很失望吧。
但现在别担心……

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm here to support you guys
by providing carts...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
我在这里支持你们，
提供手推车……

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^3355FF*whispers*^000000
^555555I am not supposed to do this
because it's against our
company policy. But I felt
really sorry for Super Novices
...so here I am.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
^3355FF*低语*^000000
^555555我不应该这样做，
因为这违反了公司政策。
但我真的很同情超级初心者
……所以我在这里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Anyway, would you like to rent a cart? The service fee is 1,900 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
总之，你想租用手推车吗？服务费是1,900泽尼。

scripts.text: Rent a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, here's the thing...
Have you learned the 'Push Cart'
skill? I can just rent you a
cart, but if you haven't
learned to push it, you'll
just be wasting your zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
哦，是这样的……
你学过“推手推车”技能吗？
我可以租给你手推车，但如果你
没学会推它，你只是浪费泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
So make sure that you have
the 'Push Cart' skill already.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
所以确保你已经学会了
“推手推车”技能。

scripts.text: Rent a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, you've already equipped a cart.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
哦，你已经装备了手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you for using my service.
Although what I am doing might
not be legitimate to other
Kafra Employees, I strongly
believe I am doing what's right for the customers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
谢谢你使用我的服务。
虽然我对其他卡普拉服务员来说
可能不合规，但我坚信
我是在为顾客做正确的事。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am sorry, but you do not have enough zeny with you. The service fee is 1,900 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，你身上的泽尼不够。服务费是1,900泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please come again.
Thank you for using my services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
请再来。
谢谢你使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please come again.
Thank you for using my services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
请再来。
谢谢你使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Good da--Oops...!
I don't think I can provide you
with the services you want...
Please go talk to another
Kafra employee. I apologize
for such inconvenience...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
日安——哎呀……！
我想我无法提供
你想要的服务……
请去和其他卡普拉服务员谈谈。
对此不便我表示歉意……
